tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i bsdus don khog phub blo gsal 'jug pa bde byed ces bya ba bzhugs// na mo buddha dhwa dza ye/ lung dus bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi rje/ /sa skya paṇa chen zhabs la gus btud nas/ /gang gi gsung rab mchog gi bsdus pa'i don/ /blo gsal 'jug pa bde byed 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir chos kyi rje nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ skye ba du ma sbyangs pa dang / /mkhas pa du ma bsten pa dang / /rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros kyis/ /shes bya kun la 'jigs med thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi don dang ldan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa sa paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos chen po sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes bya ba 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs pa'i bstan bcos yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyams len thams cad sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len du 'dus shing / sdom pa gsum ni bstan bcos 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ sdom pa gsum gyi tha snyad ni rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las bshad pa yin te/ rgyud de nyid las/ sdom pa gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /so so thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin rang gi ngo bo'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i bstan bcos chen po 'di'i bsdus don khog phub 'chad pa la don lnga ste/ mtshan don bstan pa/ mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba/ gzhung don bshad pa/ mdzad byang smos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi zhes sogs kyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ bla ma dam pa zhes sogs dang / bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab seng ge'i sgra zhes sogs nas/ 'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ dad ldan sangs rgyas gsung bzhin zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bzhi pa gzhung don bshad pa la bzhi ste/ so thar dang /

byang sems dang / gsang sngags dang / gzhung spyi'i rtsod spong sogs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba'o/ /dang so thar la/ nyan thos so thar dang / theg chen so thar gnyis las/ nyan thos so thar la bstan khrims bdun ni ji srid 'tsho'i mtha' can yin pas rten gyi gang zag shi 'phos pa'i tshe gtong ba'i sgrub byed rgyas par bshad nas 'bri khung pa rnams shi 'phos kyang rjes su 'brang bar 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ nyan thos theg chen lugs gnyis yod/ /ces pa nas/ sde snod rnam dbye med par zad/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bsnyen gnas so thar la blangs pa'i yul dang len pa'i gang zag sogs nyan thos nang phan tshun dang / theg pa che chung ma 'dres par bshad nas/ bka' gdams pa rnams bsnyen gnas 'bul ba dang / gzhan la 'chol ba dang lha bsgom pa tha dad pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ bye brag smra ba'i bsnyen gnas kyang / /zhes pa nas/ yi dam bsgom pa bsod nams che/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ theg chen so thar la/ cho ga nub pa dang ma nub pa sogs dbye ba so sor phye nas ding sang lag len du 'os pa'i cho ga bye brag tu 'chad pa ni/ theg pa chen po las byung ba'i/ /zhes pa nas/ byang sems so so thar par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ theg chen so thar len pa'i cho ga la 'phros nas/ theg chen so thar gyi bslab bya'i khyad par bye brag tu 'chad pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /zhes pa nas/ de 'dra'i rnam dbye shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ zhar la de'i gtong tshul ni theg chen so sor thar yin yang / /zhes pa nas/ de yi 'bras bu shi yang 'byung / /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ theg pa che chung gnyis ka mthun par las 'bras la blang dor tshul bzhin du byed pa ni so thar gyi bslab bya'i gtso bo yin pas 'chad pa ni/ de nas las dang rnam smin gyi/ /zhes pa nas/ da gzod las kyi rgyu 'bras la/ /shin tu mkhas pa nyid du 'gyur/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ /las 'bras la 'phros nas bod kyi zhang g.yu brag pa sogs gshis la dge sdig yod par 'dod pa'i log rtog dang / 'bri khung pa kha cig las kyi 'bras bu dkar nag zangs thal du 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni rim pa bzhin du/ mu stegs grangs can pa rnams ni/ /zhes pa nas/ mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / nyan thos dge ba phal cher yang / /zhes pa nas/ mkhas pa'i gzhung bzhin shes par gyis/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bslab bya'i khyad par la 'phros nas/ 'bri khung pa kha cig theg pa che chung gi bslab bya la gcig la bkag pa thams cad la ye nas bkag pa dang / gcig la gnang ba thams cad la ye nas gnang bar 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni/ ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba'ang / /sangs rgyas bstan dang mthun ma yin/ /zhes pa nas/ bslab pa 'chal dang sngags sbyor ba'i/ /byed po sangs rgyas yin par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis dgag pa'i bslab bya sbu gu can dang / gong pa can sogs 'dul ba'i spyod pa ma yin pas spang dgos pa dang / bslab pa'i bslab bya mdo bskul sogs 'dul ba'i gzhung dang mthun par bya dgos par 'chad pa ni/ sbu gu can dang gong pa can/ /zhes sogs dang / mdo bskul la sogs bya ba kun/ /'dul ba'i gzhung dang mthun par gyis/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bod dag sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnam dag la nyan bshad mi byed par blun po rnams kyis rang dgar sbyar ba'i bstan bcos la nyan bshad byed pa ni cher blun zhing 'khrul pa yin pas de bkag nas thos bsam sgom gsum ma nor bar bsgrub tshul 'chad pa ni la la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de rnams kyis skabs dang po so thar sdom pa'i bsdus don khog phub bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ sdug bsngal mi zad 'khor ba'i btson ra chen po nas/

/gtan du thar pa'i rnam par grol ba don gnyer blos/ /gzhan la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa kun spangs te/ /'dod chung chog shes yun du bsten pa so thar sdom/ /gnyis pa byang sems sdom pa'i nyams len ni/ spyir sems bskyed la/ nyan thos lugs dang / theg chen lugs gnyis las/ dang po la theg pa gsum gyi sems bskyed gsum dang / phyi ma la dbu sems kyi lugs gnyis yod cing / de gnyis la yang dang po len pa'i cho ga dang bslab bya sogs tha dad du yod ces spyir bstan pa ni/ sems bskyed la ni nyan thos dang / /zhes pa nas/ bslab par bya ba'ang so sor yod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ cho ga'i skabs su bka' gdams pa kha cig sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed skye bo kun la byed pa dang / don dam sems bskyed cho gas len pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni rim pa bzhin du/ sems tsam pa yi sems bskyed ni/ /zhes dang / don dam sems bskyed ces bya ba/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bslab bya'i skabs su dbu sems thun mong du ltung ba'i rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / 'bri khung pa kha cig bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom du mi rung bar 'dod pa'i log rtog dgag pa ni rim pa bzhin du/ de ltar sems tsam dbu ma gnyis/ /zhes sogs dang / byang chub sems kyi bslab pa la/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de ltar sems bskyed kyi cho ga dang / bslab bya'i 'og tu sems bskyed kyi nyams len gyi gnad ma 'chugs pa dgos tshul bye brag tu 'chad pa ni/ sems bskyed kyi nyams len gyi gnad 'chugs na sangs mi rgya bar bstan pa/ gnad 'chugs pa ma dag pa'i sbyin sogs ngos bzung ba/ lhag bsam dag pas thos bsam sgom ma 'khrul bar byed par gdams pa gsum rim pa bzhin du/ byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chugs na/ /zhes sogs dang / sangs rgyas dgongs pa mi shes par/ /zhes sogs dang / mdor na sangs rgyas gsung rab dang /

/zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de rnams kyis skabs gnyis pa byang sems sdom pa'i bsdus don khog phub bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ ma gyur 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dngos rgyu bsal slad du/ /don gnyis mthar phyin kun mkhyen sangs rgyas yid byed blos/ /rang nyid rtag tu gces par 'dzin pa'i sems spangs te/ /gzhan phan bsam sbyor rgyun du brtan pa byang sems sdom/ /gsum pa gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'i nyams len bstan pa la/ smin byed nor ba med pa'i dbang bzhi/ grol byed 'khrul pa med pa'i rim pa gnyis/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po/ phyag chen goms pa las 'khor 'das bsre ba'i spyod pa spyad pa la/ de la brten nas sa lam bgrod de 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshul dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len thams cad smin grol gnyis su 'dus pa las/ smin byed kyi dbang ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor du cho ga 'khrul pa med pas dbang bskur ba la brten slob mas sngags sdom thob pa de la 'jog pa yin no zhes pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zhugs te/ /zhes pa nas/ de yi sdom pa gsum ldan 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ deng sang bod 'dir ni phyag rgya pa kha cig byin rlabs tsam smin byed kyi dbang du 'dod pa/ grangs nges med pa dbang bskur byed pa/ dkyil 'khor ma dag par dbang bskur byed pa/ cho ga ma dag pas dbang bskur byed pa/ dbang bskur med kyang zab lam bsgom pa/ dbang po rab 'bring phye nas smra ba/ sems bskyed tsam gyis gsang sngags bsgom pa/ gtor ma dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur smin byed du 'dod pa/ dbang bskur phyi nas khas len byed pa/ sems nyid rtogs na dbang mi dgos par 'dod pa/ cho ga med pa bla ma'i lus dkyil tsam las smin byed len pa/ bya rgyud sogs la'ang dbang bzhi dang rim gnyis yod par 'dod pa/

sngags la mos pa chos sgor byas nas zab lam bsgom rung du 'dod pa/ dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa dang bcu bzhi tsam byung ba rim pa bzhin du dgag pa ni/ deng sang rdo rje phag mo yis/ /zhes sogs kyis dang po dang / des na nyan thos theg pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis gnyis pa dang / deng sang byin rlabs mi byed cing / /zhes sogs kyis gsum pa dang / dbang bskur byed pa phal cher yang / /zhes sogs kyis bzhi pa dang / dbang bskur med kyang lam zab mo/ /zhes sogs kyis lnga pa dang / kha cig gang zag dbang po rab/ /ces sogs kyis drug pa dang / la la sems bskyed byas pa la/ /zhes sogs kyis bdun pa dang / gtor ma'i dbang bskur zhes bya dang / /zhes sogs kyis brgyad pa dang / 'ga' zhig gsang sngags da lta spyod/ /ces sogs kyis dgu pa dang / la la sems nyid ma rtogs na/ /zhes sogs kyis bcu pa dang / kha cig cho ga med bzhin du/ /zhes sogs kyis bcu gcig pa dang / kha cig bya ba'i rgyud sogs la'ang / /zhes sogs kyis bcu gnyis pa dang / la la dbang bskur ma byas kyang / /zhes sogs kyis bcu gsum pa dang / la la dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod/ /ces sogs kyis bcu bzhi pa dbang bskur mu bzhir 'dod pa dgag pa bstan/ zhar la kha cig gsang grogs kyi ltung ba med par 'dod pa dgag pa ni/ kha cig gsang sngags gsang ba la/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ grol byed rim gnyis la phyag rgya ba kha cig sngon gyi grub thob rnams thabs lam re re bas grol ba yin pas/ rim pa gnyis char bsgom pa la dgos pa med do/ /zhes smra ba rnams bkag nas/ sa skya pa rang lugs la bla med kyi lam rim pa gnyis su bsgrub ste sangs rgya ba la thabs shes tshang ba dgos so zhes pa ston pa la/ kha cig 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med/ /ces pa nas/ de phyir 'di la mkhas rnams kun/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de las 'phros nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba sdom gsum len tshul/ sngags kyi lam bskyed rim dang gtum mo bsgom tshul/

mdo sngags kyi bla ma'i khyad par rnams la 'khrul pa 'gog pa dang / gnad kyi don sdom pa dang mi ldan na dge sbyong du mi 'gyur/ sems bskyed ma thob na rgyal sras su mi 'gyur/ dbang bskur ma thob na gsang sngags par mi 'gyur zhes pa ni/ gang dag rab tu byung 'dod na/ /zhes pa nas/ sngags pa dbang bskur med pa gsum/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i chom rkun yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i ye shes phyag chen la/ mtshon byed dpe dang mtshon bya don gnyis te/ dang po'i skabs su cho ga 'ga' zhig gi byed pas rtogs pa nang du kha tshom pa tsam la phyag chen du 'dod pa bkag nas/ rang lugs kyi phyag chen ngos bzung ba dang / gzhan lugs kyi phyag chen rgya nag lugs su bstan pa sogs ni/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom na yang / /zhes pa nas/ byin rlabs sangs rgyas rnams kyi yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ de las 'phros nas/ kha cig da lta gsang sngags kyi chos la dad pa che na skye ba snga ma dbang bskur thob pa zhig yin pas da lta phyag chen gyi bsgyur dbang bskur ba mi dgos zer ba dgag pa ni/ kha cig skye ba snga ma la/ /zhes pa nas/ de la kho bo ngo mtshar skye/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ mtshon bya don la/ kha cig zhi gnas cung zad tsam dang / snang stong zung 'jug gi rtogs pa phra mo skyes pa la mthong lam du ngo sprod byed pa dgag pa ni/ la la zhi gnas cung zad dang / /zhes pa nas/ des na nged kyi mthong lam ni/ /'phags pa min la 'byung mi srid/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ zhar las 'phros pa theg pa gsum gyi lag len dang / theg pa che chung gi bla ma'i dbye ba dang / dbang bskur dang po sogs ma thob par de dang de'i lam bsgom pa dgag pa dang / gtor ma dang phud mchod kyi lag len la 'khrul pa 'gog pa dang / lha'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan la 'khrul pa 'gog pa dang / rab gnas dang sbyin sreg gsang 'dus sogs mdo lugs su 'dod pa dgag pa ni rim pa bzhin/

theg pa gsum gyi lag len yang / /zhes sogs dang / nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma ni/ /zhes sogs dang / dbang bskur dang po ma thob par/ /zhes sogs dang / gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /zhes sogs dang / sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba yis/ /zhes sogs dang / yi dam lha yi sgrub thabs dang / /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ rtogs bya spros bral gyi lta ba la/ theg pa rim pa dgu la lta ba tha dad yod par 'dod pa dang / dbu ma nas bzung ste gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi la lta ba tha dad yod par 'dod pa dang / rnal 'byor bzhi la lta ba tha dad yod pa rnams dgag pa ni rim pa bzhin/ la la theg pa rim dgu la/ /zhes sogs dang / kha cig dbu ma'i lta ba ni/ /zhes sogs dang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba rnams ni/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ zhar la rgyud sde bzhi'i sgrub thabs la 'khrul pa dgag pa ni/ rgyud sde bzhi yi sgrub pa yang / /zhes pa nas/ rang bzo'i rnam thar spyod pa mtshar/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzhi pa spyod pa ni/ blang dor gnyis su der rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa brtan pa chen po la gnas pa des/ nang gi gnas sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rlung sems dbu mar thim ste sa bcu gsum pa'i rtogs pa rnams bgrod par bya ba dang / phyi rol 'dzam bu'i gling gi pu li ra ma la ya la sogs pa'i yul rnams dang / der gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams dbang du bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir/ phyi rol gyi yul can so bdun du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la rgyu ba yin pa las/ bod 'dir ni dbang bskur dang rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa ci yang med pa la sgom chen du rlom pa dag spyod pa la rgyu ba dang / gang du rgyu ba'i gnas kyang ti se la gangs can du 'khrul pa dang / rtsa ri la ri tra ru 'khrul pa rnams 'gog pa ni/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /zhes pa nas/ yul der 'gro ba rgyud las bkag /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshul ni/

mthar thug gi 'bras bu dang / gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lam thabs shes zung 'jug bsgom pa las/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa yang zung 'jug yin pa zhig thob pa yin mod kyang / kha cig dkar po chig thub las 'bras bu sku gsum 'byung ba 'dod pa dang / zung 'jug bsgom pa las 'bras bu 'od gsal gcig tu 'dod pa dang / sa lam ma bgrod par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa dang / dbang bzhi dang lam bzhi med par 'bras bu sku bzhi 'dod pa dang / 'bras bu'i mthar thug 'od gsal du 'dod pa rnams 'gog pa ni/ kha cig dkar po chig thub las/ /zhes pa nas/ lta ba mthar thug yin par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni/ sa dang po yan chad thob pa la grub thob ces pa'i tha snyad mdo sngags gnyis ka mthun par gsungs/ de las gzhan rtogs ldan nyid ched du bzang bar ma gsungs kyang / kha cig grub thob las rtogs ldan bzang zhes pa dang / nyams ngan la go ba 'bring rtogs pa bzang bar 'dod pa dang / rtse gcig dang spros bral sogs kyi rnal 'byor bzhi pa'i rim pa dang sbyor ba dgag pa ni rim pa bzhin/ la la grub thob ngan zhes zer/ /zhes sogs dang / la la nyams dang go ba dang / /zhes sogs dang / rtse gcig dang ni spros bral dang / /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de yan chad kyis sdom gsum so so'i skabs bstan zin nas/ da ni gzhung spyi la rtsod pa spangs pa sogs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba ston te/ de yang theg pa rang sa na bden pas dgag bsgrub la nges pa med do/ /zhes smra ba 'gog pa dang / chos kyi gnad ma 'chugs pa gal che bar ston pa dang / gnad bcos pa'i bdud ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gleng gzhi dang bcas te ston pa dang / 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' lung rigs kyis sun 'byin pa'i tshul gleng gzhi dang bcas te ston pa dang / bye brag tu lung gis sun 'byin pa'i tshul/ lung sbyor ji ltar byed pa'i tshul/

khungs nas ma byung ba'i gdams ngag dang / mdo rgyud du grags pa rnams tshad mar mi rung bar bstan pa/ sku gzugs ring bsrel dang / glo bur gyi ltas rnams mkhas pa la dris nas rtog dpyod bya dgos par bstan pa dang / tshig la 'khrul pa dgag pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ kha cig theg pa rang sa nas/ /zhes sogs dang / chos gzhan legs par bstan na yang / /zhes sogs dang / de la gnad rnams bcos pa'i bdud/ /ces sogs dang / 'khrul pa'i grub mtha' sun 'byin pa'i/ /zhes sogs dang / gal te lung dang 'gal gyur na/ /zhes sogs dang / blun po mkhas par 'chos pa 'ga'/ /zhes sogs dang / snyan brgyud dang ni tshig brgyud du/ /zhes sogs dang / ring bsrel dang ni thugs dang ljags/ /zhes sogs dang / de nas tshig la 'khrul pa yi/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ sangs rgyas gsung rab dri ma med/ /ces sogs kyis sngar rgya bod du chos log byung ba rnams skyes chen gong mas bkag tshul rgyas par bshad nas/ deng sang chos log 'phel ba rnams kyang 'gog rigs par bstan/ bdag ni sems can kun la bsam/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan bcos rtsom pa'i kun slong lhag bsam rnam par dag pa bstan/ bdag gis sgra dang tshad ma bslabs/ /zhes sogs kyis ni bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu mkhas pa'i shes rab bstan pa yin no/ /spyi don lnga pa mdzad byang smos pa ni/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de rnams kyis skabs gsum pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i bsdus don khog phub 'phros don dang bcas pa ma tshang ba med pa bshad zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ 'khrul ngor snang ba'i tha mal snod bcud snang ba 'di/ /snang stong rang bzhin lha sku bde stong rol ba'i ngang / /rang bzhin 'od gsal 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ro gcig tu/ /'dzin med goms 'dris rgyun tu brtan pa gsang sngags sdom/ /de dag gis ni spyir gzhung don 'chad pa'i tshul la/ dgos don/ bsdus don/

tshig don/ mtshams sbyar/ brgal lan dang lnga yod pa'i nang nas/ bsdus don gyi sgo nas gzhung 'chad tshul bstan pa yin la/ de la yang gzhung spyi'i bsdus don dang / gzhung so so'i bsdus don gnyis las/ 'dir bshad pa ni phyi ma yin te/ gzhung gi dbu zhabs ma lus pa'i don bsdus pa'i sgo nas khog phub pa ni gzhung so so'i bsdus don dang / gzhung spyi'i lus rnam par gzhag pa tsam ni gzhung spyi'i bsdus don yin pas so/ /de skad du mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo las/ bsdus pa'i don la rnam gnyis te/ /ngag don bsdus te bstan pa dang / /gzhung don so so'i bsdus don no/ /don 'dus tshig gsal brjod pa bde/ /ngag nyung tshig snyoms bzung ba sla/ /bsdus don nyid kyis gzhung go ba/ /de 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen gyi/ /gsung rab mchog gi bsdus don khog phub 'di/ /tshad ldan mkhas pa'i legs bshad rgya mtsho la/ /blo gsal 'jug pa bde phyir kho bos spel/ /kye ma zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa'i mjug /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di ngan pas khyab pa'i dus/ /blang dor shes pa'i mkhas pa nyin skar tsam/ /kyi hud 'di la bsam gyin mchi ma dku/ /'on kyang bdag ni las 'phro cher bzang bas/ /skyon med bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung zhing / /shes bya kun la 'jigs med blo rgyas pas/ /deng sang 'di na dpyod ldan kun gyis bsngags/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i legs bshad chu 'dzin las/ /bsdus don ngo mtshar char 'di kho bos phab/ /'di la skal bzang blo gsal rma bya rnams/ /dga' bas legs bshad gar gyis kun dgyes mdzod/ /ces bstan bcos chen po sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i bsdus don khog phub blo gsal 'jug pa bde byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur pa rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len zhing mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

kā la du ti'i lo/ he manta zhes pa'i dus kyi tshim byed kyi zla ba'i rdzogs pa lnga pa'i nyin dpal sa skya'i gnas mchog chu mig rdzing kha'i bla brang bde mchog pho brang gi sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyi gzim chung bde ba can gyi nyi 'od 'khyil par sbyar ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 a myes zhabs/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba'i bsdus don khog phub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
